A while back, someone told me that the Olkalou by-election was a win for William Ruto. I didn't understand it then, but I understand it now. Weeks before 17th July 2026, the government knew they would lose the by-election, but they continued investing anyway. Why? Probably because they wanted our guy Riggy G to come out with a huge win.  Reason being, the same way Rigathi knows William Ruto, is the same way William Ruto knows Rigathi. And one thing about Rigathi is that he doesn't know how to handle victory. You saw how he bashed our guy Uhuru Kenyatta during their swearing-in. You see, William Ruto understands one thing: the only way he can get a second term is through a disjointed opposition, and only one man can deliver that for him: a powerful Rigathi Gachagua.  The Olkalou by-election win made Rigathi feel like the most powerful man in the opposition. The members of parliament who impeached him will tell you that Rigathi with power is a menace. It is either his way or the highway. And if you are dissatisfied, he will tell you to go and hug a transformer. Ama umeze wembe Now, back to the so-called United Opposition. Just observe the unity before and after the Olkalou by-election. Listen to Rigathi's sentiments toward the other principals before and after it. Observe his actions before and after it. Previously, the United Opposition principals met regularly, with Rigathi Gachagua present at every meeting. But go find the photos from the two meetings the principals held after the by-election. Rigathi actually sent his deputy, Cleophas Malala. He was bigger than those meetings. And you still believe William Ruto lost in Olkalou? Look at the purported divisions in the United Opposition. Did they come before or after the Olkalou by-election? All fingers point to one person. So I don't believe what Moses Kuria is saying, that Rigathi Gachagua was paid by William Ruto. No.  Just make Rigathi Gachagua powerful and he will do your work of causing division in the opposition. 😂lelaldos ohh 😂🤣 #gachagua  #siasa  #sisindiosifuna  #tutam #fyp
